probes.description: Protocol-level Logging is deprecated in MCP 2026-07-28 and must not be relied on as the security telemetry plane. Check whether server/discover still advertises the logging capability.

assertions.description: Deprecated protocol Logging capability should not be advertised

remediation: Migrate diagnostic logging to stderr (stdio) and security telemetry to OpenTelemetry with W3C Trace Context propagated in _meta. Inventory remaining uses of deprecated features (Roots, Sampling, Logging) and remove them within lifecycle deadlines (CoSAI MCP Security v2.0 §3.2.10 and §3.3.2, Deprecated feature migration).
